title: INTERPRETABLE AUDIO EDITING EVALUATION VIA CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT DIFFERENCE-COMMONALITY REASONING WITH MULTIMODAL LLMS
reasoning: The paper presents an automated evaluation framework for audio editing using Multimodal Large Language Models. Although it utilizes a metric called 'Faith_score', this is a technical measurement of the 'faithfulness' of the edited audio to its original characteristics and does not involve religion, morals, or ethics.
